<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" name="viewport"/>
<title>NIGHT — Discography</title>
<meta content="NIGHT official discography archive." name="description"/>
<link href="assets/css/style.css" rel="stylesheet"/>

<style>
/* PHANTOM 09.07 tracklist inline */
.phantom-tracklist-meta{grid-column:1/-1}
.phantom-tracklist{
  list-style:none;
  margin:10px 0 0;
  padding:0;
  display:grid;
  gap:0;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);
}
.phantom-tracklist li{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:42px minmax(0,1fr) auto;
  align-items:center;
  gap:12px;
  padding:11px 0;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);
}
.phantom-tracklist li b{
  color:var(--muted);
  font-size:9px;
  font-weight:400;
  letter-spacing:.12em;
}
.phantom-tracklist li strong{
  color:#ddd8e8;
  font-size:11px;
  font-weight:500;
  letter-spacing:.08em;
}
.phantom-tracklist li em{
  padding:4px 8px;
  border:1px solid rgba(184,168,255,.34);
  border-radius:999px;
  color:#c8b7ee;
  font-size:7px;
  font-style:normal;
  letter-spacing:.15em;
}
</style>


<style>
/* PHANTOM 09.08 package preview inline */
.phantom-package-preview{margin-top:26px;padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.78fr) minmax(320px,1.22fr);gap:28px;align-items:start}
.phantom-package-copy span{display:block;margin-bottom:8px;color:var(--purple-soft);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.16em}
.phantom-package-copy h3{margin:0 0 12px;color:#eeeaf5;font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;font-size:24px;font-weight:500}
.phantom-package-copy p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;line-height:1.8}
.phantom-package-preview a{display:block;border:1px solid rgba(184,168,255,.16);overflow:hidden}
.phantom-package-preview img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
@media(max-width:860px){.phantom-package-preview{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>


<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/css/discography-text.css">
